products.text:
Type: distressed hand-tufted area rug
Use: defining a seating or bed area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: hand-tufted cotton and wool, low pile
Colors: ivory, dark teal blue
Shape: rectangular, distressed grid of broken lines, denser blue toward one end, clean edges, medium size, flat profile
Feel: fresh, artistic, relaxed
Goes with: white walls, light wood floors, teal or navy accents; modern or coastal rooms

Type: textured bohemian area rug
Use: grounding a chair or seating corner; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: bohemian, contemporary, farmhouse
Materials: woven yarn with raised high-low pile, short fringe
Colors: cream white, grey, charcoal
Shape: rectangular, raised cream trellis and diamond bands over herringbone stripes, fringed ends, medium size
Feel: cozy, tactile, casual
Goes with: dark wood, woven baskets, neutral walls; boho or farmhouse rooms

Type: leather and metallic flatweave rug
Use: anchoring a living or bedroom layout; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: woven leather strips, metallic yarn, flatweave
Colors: warm beige, silver, light tan
Shape: large rectangle, faded horizontal streaks, subtle sheen, flat and low
Feel: soft, warm, understated
Goes with: dark wood floors, grey upholstery, natural baskets; neutral modern rooms

Type: ombré wool area rug
Use: color statement under seating; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: wool, fine low pile
Colors: bright red, warm orange-red
Shape: rectangular, solid fade from red to coral, finely textured surface, clean edges, medium-large
Feel: bold, warm, energetic
Goes with: dark wood, grey or white furniture, neutral walls; modern rooms

Type: distressed vintage-style area rug
Use: accent under a console or seating; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: traditional, contemporary, bohemian
Materials: low-pile woven yarn, worn-look finish
Colors: light aqua blue, navy, grey, ivory
Shape: rectangular, faded medallion with ornate border, distressed texture, thin flat profile, compact
Feel: relaxed, timeworn, cool
Goes with: rustic wood, brick, white walls, green plants; farmhouse or eclectic rooms

Type: chevron wool runner rug
Use: covering a hallway or bedside floor; hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: modern, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: hand-tufted wool, solid and heathered blocks
Colors: ivory, sky blue, forest green, grey, charcoal
Shape: long narrow runner, color-blocked chevron stripes, clean edges, low pile
Feel: fresh, playful, cool
Goes with: white walls, dark wood floors, blue or green accents; modern rooms

Type: large ornate area rug
Use: anchoring a sofa seating area; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: traditional, contemporary, classic
Materials: woven low pile, dotted pattern
Colors: charcoal grey, white
Shape: large rectangle, dotted damask scrolls and central diamond, patterned border, flat
Feel: elegant, calm, refined
Goes with: white sofas, light wood floors, grey and cream textiles; classic or farmhouse rooms

Type: southwestern patterned area rug
Use: colorful base for seating; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: bohemian, contemporary
Materials: woven pile yarn
Colors: cream, magenta red, orange, navy, light blue
Shape: rectangular, rows of diamond motifs in stripes, zigzag edges, medium size, low pile
Feel: lively, warm, eclectic
Goes with: dark wood, woven baskets, white walls; boho or southwestern rooms

Type: textured chevron area rug
Use: anchoring a living or bedroom layout; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: cotton, raised carved texture
Colors: grey, light grey, taupe
Shape: large rectangle, tone-on-tone raised zigzag stripes, plain border, flat
Feel: calm, subtle, tidy
Goes with: grey upholstery, dark wood floors, natural baskets; modern neutral rooms

Type: diamond patterned runner rug
Use: covering a hallway or bedside floor; hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: contemporary, modern, bohemian
Materials: hand-tufted yarn, raised plush texture
Colors: ivory, charcoal grey
Shape: long narrow runner, concentric diamond pattern, raised pile lines, low profile
Feel: graphic, cozy, crafted
Goes with: dark wood floors, woven baskets, white walls; modern or boho rooms
